newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids mostly steady.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were msotly steady and movement was quiet, grain merchandisers in the U.S. High Plains said Monday.

Meanwhile, dealers said the cold temperatures seen Friday and Saturday in Kansas and Oklahoma probably caused little, if any, damage to the HRW wheat crop. They explained that most of the HRW wheat plants in northern Oklahoma and southern Kansas have not yet developed a head -- the grain-containing part of the plant that would be most susceptible to cold temperatures.
"I haven't heard anybody talk about damage," a Kansas dealer said.
"Nobody out here seems too concerned about it," a north central Oklahoma dealer said. "With the ground temperature out here being so warm, any damage was probably minimal."
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: K=KCBT May wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
